document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
A sudden unspeakable dread consumes you. Before you, within 
the pit, a blasphemy of tentacles, claws, and utter horror resides. 
It has a name… Ghatanothoa! Make a Sanity roll and lose 
1D10/1D100 Sanity points.
The festering mass turns toward you, waving its hundred 
tentacles in the air as if in some mocking welcome. As you choke 
out a scream, you feel your flesh begin to tighten and go rigid 
as an unnatural paralysis takes hold. Then the gigantic bubble-
mass creatures come; bloated things covered eyes and yawning 
maws—you remember them from the mosaics. 
If you have the rose colored amulet, you have only a moment 
to touch it before you turn to stone, go to 592.
If you have only the ring, the bubble-creatures seem to respect 
its power and leave it untouched, but the same is not true for 
you! As you are enveloped and torn apart! It is ... THE END.
(565, 580)
